definitions.explanation: A written account of events or information preserved for reference.
The best performance or highest achievement, especially in sports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{記録|きろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took notes of the meeting.

{記録|きろく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{記録|きろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}って→破る：02321_yaburu⟧、⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧⟦メダル→メダル：10162_medaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: He broke the world record in the 100 meters and won the gold medal.

notes:
{記録|きろく} has two main senses: (1) a written record or documentation of events, and (2) an achievement record, especially in sports.

SENSE 1 — DOCUMENTATION:
- {記録|きろく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to record, to document
- {記録|きろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take notes/keep a record
- {記録|きろく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to remain on record

SENSE 2 — ACHIEVEMENT:
- {記録|きろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to break a record
- {記録|きろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新：04765_koushin⟧: to update/set a new record
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{記録|きろく}: world record
- {新|しん}{記録|きろく}: new record

COMMON PATTERNS:
Functions as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb ({記録|きろく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to record).
